namingRule.rule: Every operation is listed as <packageId>.<operationId>; a declared alias is listed as well, with the same input schema and the alias description or else the operation's.

source.method: Read from Firedrill Tool manifests. No MCP server was started and no network was used.

notes: Gmail has no alias for sending. Sending exists only as the canonical gmail.messages.send and gmail.drafts.send.

Google's own pages disagree with each other and with these aliases. https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/configure-mcp-server lists 9 Gmail tools, without create_label, update_label, delete_label or get_message; https://developers.google.com/workspace/guides/configure-mcp-servers lists 10, adding get_message. https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/guides/configure-mcp-server lists 8 Calendar tools without search_events; the Workspace overview lists 9 with it.

toolsets.aliasProvenance: Google Gmail MCP tool and argument names as captured by the Firedrill Tool on 2026-09-13 (packages/gmail/README.md).

aliases.name: create_draft
aliases.description: Creates a new draft email in the authenticated user's mailbox.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

raw.description: base64url RFC 2822 message (Gmail wire format). Mutually exclusive with structured fields.

aliases.name: create_label
aliases.description: Creates a new label in the authenticated user's mailbox.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

aliases.name: delete_label
aliases.description: Deletes a label in the authenticated user's mailbox.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

aliases.name: get_thread
aliases.description: Retrieves a specific thread, including its messages.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

restFormat.description: Render the thread for a Gmail REST Message format (the get-thread route sets it from ?format=). minimal returns only the REST minimal fields of each message; metadata and full return the summaries (full implies FULL_CONTENT). The byte budget is measured on what is returned and on its REST rendering, whichever is larger.

aliases.name: label_message
aliases.description: Adds one or more labels to a specific message.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

aliases.name: label_thread
aliases.description: Adds labels to an entire thread.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

aliases.name: list_drafts
aliases.description: Lists drafts in the authenticated user's mailbox.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

aliases.name: list_labels
aliases.description: Lists user labels in the authenticated user's mailbox.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

pageSize.description: Labels per page (default 20). Pages also stop before about 900 KB of UTF-8 JSON and carry a nextPageToken. The REST route passes 10000 so GET …/labels is unpaged like Gmail's; a whole list above that byte budget is refused with FAILED_PRECONDITION. User labels are bounded by the mailbox's label bound (500 unless mailboxes.limits.labels says otherwise).

aliases.name: search_threads
aliases.description: Searches threads in the authenticated user's mailbox using Gmail query syntax.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

withoutMessages.description: Return each thread as id, snippet and historyId only, without message summaries (the Gmail REST threads.list shape). Pages are filled up to the response byte budget on the shape returned.

aliases.name: unlabel_message
aliases.description: Removes one or more labels from a specific message.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

aliases.name: unlabel_thread
aliases.description: Removes labels from an entire thread.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

aliases.name: update_label
aliases.description: Updates an existing label in the authenticated user's mailbox.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

canonicalOnly.name: gmail.drafts.send
canonicalOnly.description: Send a draft: the draft disappears and a SENT message with a new id appears. FAILED_PRECONDITION when a recipient mailbox or its thread (200 messages) is full.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

canonicalOnly.name: gmail.drafts.update
canonicalOnly.description: Replace the content of a draft (PUT semantics); threadId or replyToMessageId moves it into that thread (FAILED_PRECONDITION when that thread already holds 200 messages).

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

raw.description: base64url RFC 2822 message (Gmail wire format). Mutually exclusive with structured fields.

threadId.description: Move the draft into this existing thread (NOT_FOUND otherwise); In-Reply-To/References are set to the thread's last message. Omit to keep the draft where it is.

canonicalOnly.name: gmail.messages.batch-modify
canonicalOnly.description: Add and remove labels on up to 100 messages atomically.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

canonicalOnly.name: gmail.messages.list
canonicalOnly.description: List message ids matching a Gmail search query; TRASH and SPAM are excluded unless requested.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

canonicalOnly.name: gmail.messages.modify
canonicalOnly.description: Add and remove labels on one message.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

canonicalOnly.name: gmail.messages.send
canonicalOnly.description: Synthetic send: stores a SENT copy and delivers INBOX copies only to mailboxes in this world. FAILED_PRECONDITION when the mailbox, a recipient mailbox or the target thread (200 messages) is full.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

raw.description: base64url RFC 2822 message (Gmail wire format). Mutually exclusive with structured fields.

canonicalOnly.name: gmail.messages.trash

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

canonicalOnly.description: Read the current mailbox profile (address, counts, history id) plus the world's virtual time.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

canonicalOnly.name: gmail.threads.modify
canonicalOnly.description: Add and remove labels on every message of a thread.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.

canonicalOnly.name: gmail.threads.trash
canonicalOnly.description: Move every message of a thread to TRASH.

userId.description: "me" or the actor's own mailbox address; anything else is refused with FORBIDDEN.
